reviewedBy: Claude Sonnet 5.5, the implementing agent reviewing its own work (not a cold reviewer, not a human)
method: Branch feat/album-launch-report, source commit 55cf710, on a local dev server reading production read-only through the service-role client. Walked /photography/analytics/albums/<key> for Re7kho (finished burst), DWdCET (finished), fJKdsB (top launch), jq1Rp7 (small launch), eEUGfA (no launch date, reason no_record) and 5M7kNx (no launch date, reason unobserved) at 1440x900 and 375x812 in headless Chromium, then opened the captures and fixed what showed, across two rounds: spacing and list bullets, chart label collisions and clipping, UTC versus Chicago publication day in the launch table, chart colors under 3:1, a nested second main landmark, an always-failing findings panel, a phone order that put the selected photo above its grid, and legend names cut mid-word. The findings panel now appears only when a saved calculation exists for the album scope (decided on the server from the stored snapshot); none exists for any walked album, so none showed. Below 1024 px the grid comes first and a photo opens in a native modal dialog; scripted keyboard walk at 375 px: Enter on a photo opens the dialog with focus on Close and no scroll change, Tab stays inside it, Esc and the Close button both close it and return focus to the tapped photo with no scroll change; tapping a strip photo opens it too; at 1440 px the side panel stays and no dialog opens. Also ran: See all, both table alternatives, the Albums inspector link opening this page, the album CSV link (200, album scoped). Checks: every element's box inside the viewport at both widths, with overflow hidden or clip not treated as safe (forced to fail once with a 420 px element planted inside the report's own text column), no interactive element under 44 px, a 3 px focus ring on every Tab stop, one main landmark and one h1, no overflow at 200% root text size, with forced colors and with prefers-contrast: more. An unlisted album and an unknown key return 404 signed out. Not covered: every signed-in control (Shortlist these, Record what you did, the owner-only record form shown when no saved calculation exists, owner sign-in), which was only read, not run; the findings panel itself on this page, since no album scope has a snapshot to render; screen reader use; a physical device; a cold reviewer; the in-progress, coverage-gap, just-published and not-published recap states, which render only in unit tests and in historical as-of runs of the read model; the clean analytics.ninochavez.co/albums address on the real host, which only the hook and path tests carry; the dialog on a real touch device or in Safari; Overview, Photos, Sources, Measurement, Preferences and Sites were not re-walked.
